name: @office/intelligence-margin
description: Office margin and impact engine (OFF-014): the commercial impact engine — deterministic cost/schedule/entitlement/margin impact calculations that consume the relationship engine's authorization-filtered traversals plus typed commercial facts folded from the landed domain packages' recorded event envelopes. Every assessment is a versioned ImpactAssessment carrying the exact source event ids that produced every impact number (freeze A4 evidence/provenance; traceability is real — mutating or removing a source event changes the assessment). Depends only on @office/intelligence-relationships (the ONE intelligence peer — subgraph traversals), @office/contracts (envelopes, EntityRefs, causality), @office/domain-kernel (Result/DomainError), @office/authz (deny-by-default assessment access), and @office/events (the ledger READ surface + deterministic ledger event id derivation — this package never writes the ledger; assessment events are emitted through the mirrored AssessmentEventSink port).
